dialogue.text: The Sea!
dialogue.textjp: 海ー！

dialogue.text: It's been a long time since I felt simply fun.
dialogue.textjp: 純粋に楽しむなんざ久々な気ィするわ

dialogue.text: Y'all been seeing red from day one.
dialogue.textjp: お前らずっと殺伐としてるもんな

dialogue.text: Yeah, you assassination plot was one of them, wasn't it?
dialogue.textjp: ああ、ＢＦの暗殺計画もその一つだったなぁ？

dialogue.text: Too bad, I'm so much energy.
dialogue.textjp: 残念、こんなに元気

dialogue.text: Yeah, man.
dialogue.textjp: まったくだぜ

dialogue.text: You guys started the rap battle and it got twisted, you dumbasses.
dialogue.textjp: あんたらがラップバトル始めるから拗れたのよ、バカ

dialogue.text: Glad I did it in my own thing, fr.
dialogue.textjp: 俺の得意分野で解決できてよかったよ、本当に

dialogue.text: If it weren't for that, we'd be flush with cash by now.
dialogue.textjp: それが無かったら今頃俺らは大金がっぽりだったけどな

dialogue.text: Well, well, well, forget about it.
dialogue.textjp: まーまーそんなもんは忘れちまえ

dialogue.text: Geez dude...
dialogue.textjp: お前なぁ

dialogue.text: Forget about the past and get on with it, the foodstuffs are going bad.
dialogue.textjp: 昔話はいいから早く始めるぞ、食材が悪くなる

dialogue.text: Yup!
dialogue.textjp: そうね！

dialogue.text: Sweets on the beach, after all! I'm pretty sure they're on top with the barbecue.
dialogue.textjp: やっぱりビーチにはスイーツ！バーベキューでもナンバーワン確実だわ

dialogue.text: Hey, come on, don't be silly.
dialogue.textjp: おいおい冗談だろ？

dialogue.text: It's barbecue. Obviously the only way is meat.
dialogue.textjp: バーベキューだぞ、ナンバーワンは肉に決まってる

dialogue.text: Hey, hey, hey, your jokes not funny!
dialogue.textjp: おーいおい、笑えない冗談はよせよ

dialogue.text: What a dummy on earth would not eat seafood with the sea in front of them?
dialogue.textjp: 海を目の前に魚介を食わないバカがこの世にいんのか？

dialogue.text: .......Ya gonna do it?
.......Bring it on.
.......No regrets.
dialogue.textjp: .......後悔すんなよ

dialogue.text: So hungry... Just grill it already...
dialogue.textjp: 腹減ったぁ...早く焼いちゃお
